items.performers: San Francisco Symphony; Edo de Waart
items.label: Nonesuch
items.note: The pounding E minor chords that open this orchestral work came from Adams’s dream of a supertanker lifting off San Francisco Bay. Edo de Waart and the San Francisco Symphony recorded it within days of its première, preserving the original ending.

items.performers: Sanford Sylvan, James Maddalena, Thomas Hammons, John Duykers, Carolann Page, Trudy Ellen Craney; Orchestra of St. Luke’s; Edo de Waart
items.label: Nonesuch
items.note: Alice Goodman’s verse couplets set Nixon’s 1972 visit to China on the operatic stage. James Maddalena sings Nixon and Sanford Sylvan Chou En-lai in this composer-supervised original-cast recording, conducted by Edo de Waart.

items.performers: Orchestra of St. Luke’s; John Adams
items.label: Nonesuch
items.note: Tremolos and trills send repeated patterns through the strings; the title also recalls a Shaker colony near Adams’s childhood home in New Hampshire. He conducts the Orchestra of St. Luke’s in the string-orchestra version, recorded in New York in 1988.
